beat_plan: Establish: frame the subject as a numbered architectural study
Prove: use an approved local capture or truthful designed-motion detail
Payoff: quiet rhythm with one clear final identity

direction.camera: Guide attention with architectural order; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: frame the subject as a numbered architectural study; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with index labels; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with quiet rhythm.
direction.lighting: soft gallery wash; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: concrete and technical tracing paper; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around neutral mass; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use architectural order,index labels,thin frame,measured spacing,neutral mass,quiet rhythm as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
